the phase index is not truncated to sixteen bits
why: EXPECTED UNCAUGHT.  `word_04` is a 0..5 phase counter that `if (++p == 6) p = 0` keeps in range, so truncating it to sixteen bits before the table index cannot change a subscript.  The cast is in the reconstruction because the object has `movzwl 0x4(%ebx)` at every one of those sites and not because any test can see it -- which is the whole reason the mutation is here: it says out loud that this one line rests on the instruction and not on the suite.

Recorded rather than deleted, because a deleted mutation is an untested claim nobody can see.
